The '''Great Houses''' were the six of the wealthiest and most powerful families on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone wars]], with at least two more Great Houses existing prior to that time. Among these families were the [[House Demici/Legends|Demici]] and [[House Nalju/Legends|Nalju families]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone wars]], or [[House Palerma|Palerma]] and [[House Teramo|Teramo]] during the [[Great Galactic War]].

==History==
===Early history===
{{Quote|It won't be long before the Great Houses discover I am the founder of the Anti-Republic Liberation Front. They will seize my assets and declare me a traitor.|Hetton, explaining to Zannah his situation after the failed assassination attempt|<ref name="DB:RoT" />}}
The [[Hetton's family|family]] of [[Loranda]] and her son, [[Hetton]], were related to the [[House Demici/Legends|House Demici]].

During the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]] debate, the [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Counts of Serenno]] attempted to remain neutral until [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Tarsus Valorum/Legends|Tarsus Valorum]] was nearly assassinated on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].

===Cleansing of Serenno===
{{Quote|Lord Vader! This is barbaric! You never spoke of this!''"<br />"''The rest of the Galaxy suffered, so now will Serenno. The houses will be cleansed by blood.|Adan Dooku and Darth Vader|<ref name="AotE-HT2" />}}
[[File:Cleansing_of_Serenno.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Darth Vader turned the heirs of Serenno against their fathers.]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Great Houses supported [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and the Separatists. However, after the Clone Wars, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] was sent to Serenno by [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to enact the retaliation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on the six ruling Houses, which had sided with the separatists during the war. During what was called the [[Cleansing of Serenno]], a choice was offered to the five Counts, with the exception of [[Adan Dooku]] who was in exile during the Clone Wars: be killed by their oldest sons or be killed by the Sith Lord and his troopers. [[Rodas Borgin]] killed his [[Rodas Borgin's father|father]] first followed by the others.<ref name="AotE-HT2" />

===Dooku regency===
{{Quote|The new Count, Bron Dooku, is too young to assume rule so a regent must be appointed. Normally it would go to a member of his immediate family, but there is no one. Mother and father both dead. The other Counts -- the heads of the other five Great Houses -- will meet. One of them will be appointed regent. The decision must be unanimous. Our interests lay with the head of House Borgin -- ''Rodas Borgin''. You are to do whatever is necessary to insure he is named regent.|Armand Isard explaining his next mission to Agent Jahan Cross|<ref name="AotE-HT1">[[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 1|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 1]]</ref>}}
Following the assassination of Count [[Adan Dooku]] in 3 BBY, the Lords of the other Great Houses refused to elect Lord Borgin as regent.<ref name="AotE-HT1" /> However, the Lords of the Great Houses elected Lord [[Orom Malvern]] as the new regent and Borgin's son, Pero, was named Lord of House Borgin.<ref name="AotE-HT5">[[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 5|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 5]]</ref>
